scope: Static ownership map for candidate selection, visibility, consumer gating, backend execution, and conservative fallback behavior. Source anchors describe the audited 2026-07-15 working tree; line numbers are navigation hints and symbols are the stable anchors.

statusVocabulary.verified: The source implements the stated ownership contract and this audit found no conflicting path.
statusVocabulary.partial: The primary ownership path is identified, but an adjacent path or missing declaration prevents a complete guarantee.
statusVocabulary.gap: The current source does not satisfy the intended visibility or execution ownership contract.

runtimeAssertionsRequired: Snapshot globe terrain tile IDs plus terrain and imagery revisions immediately before backend command compilation and prove both backends consume the same snapshot.
Record every draw, compute, fullscreen, shadow, and capture unit against a declared feature ID, selection owner, consumer owner, and fallback policy.
Reject SceneOctree ownership of terrain, traversal-owned 3D Tiles, voxels, compute, overlay, and commands whose cull flag delegates visibility to their producer.
Report candidate, selected, rejected, fallback, command, pass, and submission counts by feature ID without allocating when counters are disabled.
